Class ActivateState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.AdventureState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.ActivateState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeclareEnginePowerState, DeclareFirePowerState, HandleProjectileState
public abstract class ActivateState extends AdventureState
Abstract class representing a state in which the player can activate components and spend batteries on their ship board.

  • Method Details

    • skip

      public void skip(ShipBoard shipBoard)
      Skips the current state for the specified ship board.

      Skips this state if it's the given ship board's turn. If the player has batteries to spend or components to activate they will be used/activated.

      Specified by:
      skip in class GameState
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship board of the player who should skip

    • activateComponent

      public void activateComponent(ShipBoard shipBoard, Point position)
      Activates a component on the ship board at the specified position.
      Overrides:
      activateComponent in class GameState
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - the ship board on which the component is located
      position - the position of the component to activate
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if it's not the player's turn, or if the player has not enough batteries to activate the component.
